level.theme: A trial of endurance against the earth's wrath, where the player must harness volatile energies to survive.
level.setting: A dark, ash-filled volcano with glowing magma veins, unstable ground, and distant roars of molten fury. The air is thick with sulfur, and ghostly fissures in the rock hint at ancient, dormant forces.
level.player_weapon: Crystal Staff (can channel crystalline energy and manipulate earth)

encounters.location: A labyrinth of magma channels and obsidian walls.
encounters.hazard: The ground trembles as the Lava Golem erupts molten rock in all directions.

pickup.name: Crystalline Core Fragment
pickup.effect: Enhances the geomancer's weapon with crystalline energy

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Lava Golem collapses a portion of the cavern, revealing a hidden magma river leading to the next encounter.

encounters.location: A boiling magma river with floating geothermal vents.

enemy.name: Magma Serpent
enemy.weakness: Crystalline Core Fragment (obtained from the first encounter)

encounters.hazard: The serpent spews superheated steam and creates lava traps that harden into barriers.

pickup.name: Magma Resonator
pickup.effect: Disrupts volcanic energy fields when activated

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Magma Serpent triggers a seismic shockwave that cracks the volcanic crust, exposing the chamber of the final boss.

boss.name: Volcanic Titan
boss.weakness: Magma Resonator (obtained from the Magma Serpent encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Volcanic Titan using the Magma Resonator to disrupt its core

level.objective: Navigate the volatile volcanic terrain to reach the heart of the volcano and defeat the Volcanic Titan.
level.reward: Volcanic Core Crystal (grants permanent boost to geomancy abilities)

level.setting: A chaotic, unstable volcanic realm with erupting geysers, molten rivers, and collapsing rock formations.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing terrain and lava geysers

pickup.name: Volcanic Core
pickup.effect: Increases fire damage by 30%

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Lava Golem causes a fissure to open, revealing the path to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Explosive sulfur gas pockets and shifting magma flows

pickup.name: Sulfur Crystal
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to create explosive ice shards (counter to fire)

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Molten Serpent triggers a chain reaction, destabilizing the volcano and awakening the Magma Titan.

boss.name: Magma Titan
boss.weakness: Sulfur Crystal (obtained from the second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Magma Titan using the Sulfur Crystal to bypass its shield.

level.objective: Survive the chaotic volcanic environment, defeat three enemies, and use pickups to overcome the final boss.
level.reward: Volcanic Pyre (a permanent fire damage boost)

level.theme: Tense, high-pressure environment with collapsing terrain and environmental hazards
level.setting: Volcanic chamber with lava flows, geysers, and ash clouds

encounters.hazard: Lava fissures trigger tremors

pickup.name: Holy Relic
pickup.effect: Increases holy weapon damage by 25%

encounters.trigger: Fissure opens, revealing path to geothermal vent

encounters.hazard: Steam vents erupt, creating fire hazards

pickup.name: Magma Core
pickup.effect: Activates temporary shield reducing damage by 35%

encounters.trigger: Ground shakes, revealing hidden boss chamber

boss.name: Volcanic Titan
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the titan's core with Magma Core

level.objective: Navigate volcanic hazards and defeat the Volcanic Titan

level.theme: Brutal endurance trials where the environment itself attacks the player
level.setting: A desolate volcanic realm with rivers of lava, crumbling obsidian structures, and ash-choked skies. The ground cracks periodically, releasing plumes of superheated steam.
level.player_weapon: Berserker's Volcanic Axe (inflicts 20% more damage against molten foes)

encounters.hazard: Lava geysers erupt when health drops below 30%

pickup.name: Molten Core Fragment
pickup.effect: Unlocks 'Molten Core Fragment' (increases fire resistance by 30%)

encounters.trigger: Crushing the golem's molten core opens a fissure leading to the next encounter

encounters.hazard: Lava pools spawn explosive magma bubbles when attacked

pickup.name: Crystallized Obsidian Shard
pickup.effect: Unlocks 'Crystallized Obsidian Shard' (ignites enemy armor for 5 seconds)

encounters.trigger: The serpent's defeat destabilizes the cavern's ceiling, revealing the boss chamber

boss.name: Volcanic Titan
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the molten core with the Crystallized Obsidian Shard

level.objective: Reach the summit of Mount Inferno and destroy the volcanic titan
level.reward: Volcanic Titan's Heart (grants permanent 15% damage boost against elemental enemies)

level.setting: A mysterious volcanic cavern system with ancient machinery and unstable terrain. The air is thick with ash, and faint runes glow on the walls, hinting at forgotten tech.

enemy.name: Lava Golem
enemy.weakness: Cryo damage from the Artificer's starting weapon, the 'Frost Core Wrist Cannon.'

encounters.hazard: Lava flows and erupting geysers

pickup.name: Thermal Conductor
pickup.effect: Increases cryo damage by 25% and unlocks the Thermal Conductor

encounters.trigger: Destroy the Lava Golem to cool the magma channels, revealing a path to the next area.

enemy.name: Magma Worm
enemy.weakness: The 'Thermal Conductor' pickup from the first encounter. Overloading it with heat energy destabilizes the worm's core.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing rock formations and toxic gas vents

pickup.name: Volcanic Core
pickup.effect: Grants temporary invincibility and unlocks the Volcanic Core

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Magma Worm to trigger a seismic shift, revealing the entrance to the Titan's lair.

boss.name: Magma Titan
boss.weakness: The 'Volcanic Core' pickup from the Magma Worm encounter. Inserting it into the Titan's chest causes a chain reaction that weakens its armor.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Volcanic Core inside the Titan's chest using the 'Volcanic Core' pickup.

level.objective: Navigate the volcanic caverns, defeat the three threats, and use collected pickups to defeat the Magma Titan.
level.reward: Access to the 'Volcanic Core' artifact and 500 XP

level.setting: A vast volcanic cavern system with glowing magma rivers, fissures emitting sulfuric gas, and eerie bioluminescent fungi. The air is thick with ash, and distant rumblings suggest an imminent eruption.
level.player_weapon: Stormstaff (summons lightning bolts and controls weather).

encounters.hazard: Lava flows and erupting fissures.

pickup.name: Volcanic Core
pickup.effect: Amplifies lightning attacks by 50%.

encounters.trigger: The Lava Warden attacks when the player reaches the center of the chasm. Defeating it melts a blocked path forward.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing rock formations and molten rock projectiles.

pickup.name: Storm Essence
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to summon a temporary storm cloud, increasing lightning damage by 30%.

encounters.trigger: The player must use the Volcanic Core to overload the Sentinel's magma veins, triggering a fight. Defeating it reveals a hidden chamber containing the Storm Essence.

boss.name: Magma Sovereign
boss.weakness: Storm Essence (obtained from the Stone Sentinel in Encounter 2).
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Magma Sovereign by exploiting its weakness to the Storm Essence.

level.objective: Navigate the volcanic caverns, defeat three deadly enemies, and conquer the Magma Sovereign.
level.reward: Stormcaller's Resolve (permanent ability to summon a storm cloud that weakens elemental enemies).

level.setting: Whimsical volcanic landscape with playful lava creatures and colorful magma pools.

encounters.hazard: Lava River

pickup.name: Lava Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks ability to temporarily freeze lava flows

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Lava Golem causes the lava river to solidify, revealing a path to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Magma Pools

pickup.name: Cooling Gem
pickup.effect: Reflects heat damage back at enemies

encounters.trigger: After retrieving the Lava Core, the Magma Sprite emerges to 'play' with the player, blocking progress until defeated.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing Caverns

pickup.name: Volcanic Badge
pickup.effect: Unlocks a permanent fire resistance buff

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Magma Sprite reveals a hidden chamber where the Molten Jester resides, guarded by unstable magma walls.

boss.name: Molten Jester
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the Cooling Gem

level.objective: Navigate the volcanic terrain, collect key items, and defeat the Molten Jester.

level.setting: A serene volcanic valley with a river of lava, geysers, and crystalline formations. The air is still, with occasional bursts of steam. The ground is covered in obsidian, and there are pools of molten glass reflecting the sky.

encounters.hazard: Lava geysers erupting randomly

pickup.name: Chrono Crystal
pickup.effect: Enhances time manipulation abilities

encounters.trigger: The Chrono Crystal pulses, revealing a hidden path through the obsidian wall

encounters.hazard: Time distortions cause the environment to flicker between past and present

pickup.name: Time Anchor
pickup.effect: Locks time in place for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: The Time Anchor stabilizes the cavern, revealing a passage to the Sentinel's domain

encounters.hazard: Molten rock slides block the path

pickup.name: Volcanic Core Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks boss chamber

encounters.trigger: The Sentinel's destruction triggers a tremor, exposing the boss's lair

boss.name: Chronophage the Eternal
boss.weakness: Time Anchor (specific pickup from prior encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss with the Time Anchor to unlock a time-loop reward

level.objective: Navigate the volcanic terrain and defeat the Chronophage, using time-manipulation abilities and pickups to overcome each challenge
level.reward: Time-loop reward: replay the level with doubled time manipulation power

level.setting: A serene celestial temple floating in a nebula, with soft auroras and glowing celestial bodies. The environment shifts from light-filled chambers to shadowy, corrupted areas as the player progresses.
level.player_weapon: Holy Light (light-based attacks with a focus on radiant energy).

encounters.hazard: Celestial Rift (random teleports to dangerous areas).

pickup.name: Celestial Relic
pickup.effect: Increases Holy Light damage by 20% for 3 minutes.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Celestial Sentinel unlocks the path to the Shadow Corruptor's lair by repairing the temple's broken light bridge.

encounters.hazard: Gravity Wells (slow movement and pull toward the center of the arena).

pickup.name: Star Fragment
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to target the Eclipse Sovereign's core during the boss fight.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Shadow Corruptor activates the temple's celestial beacon, revealing the Eclipse Sovereign's hidden sanctum.

boss.name: Eclipse Sovereign
boss.weakness: Star Fragment (obtained from the Shadow Corruptor encounter).
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Eclipse Sovereign by exploiting its weakness to the Star Fragment.

level.objective: Protect the celestial realm from corruption by defeating three celestial threats and the Eclipse Sovereign.
level.reward: Celestial Palindrome (a glowing amulet that grants permanent 10% damage resistance and a 5% chance to reflect enemy attacks).

level.setting: A mysterious celestial realm with shifting constellations, eerie glowing nebulae, and ancient alien structures that pulse with temporal energy. Time flows unpredictably, with echoes of past and future events haunting the environment.
level.player_weapon: Chronoglaive (manipulates time, slows enemies, rewinds attacks)

encounters.hazard: Temporal Rift

pickup.name: Temporal Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks Temporal Rewind (rewind 5 seconds)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Sentinel causes a rift that opens a path to the Chronophage's domain

encounters.hazard: Time Siphon

pickup.name: Chrono-Fractal
pickup.effect: Disrupts time-based shields

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Chronophage causes a cosmic collapse, revealing the Eon Leviathan's lair

boss.name: Eon Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Break the time shield with Chrono-Fractal

level.objective: Navigate through the celestial realms, defeat the three temporal threats, and harness their weaknesses to confront the Eon Leviathan
level.reward: Celestial Chrono-Amulet (grants immunity to time-based effects)

level.theme: Ominous celestial decay; eerie silence broken by distant starbursts and the hum of unstable energy
level.setting: A crumbling temple floating in the void between stars, with glowing runes and unstable gravitational fields

encounters.hazard: Gravity Wells pull player toward crystalline spikes

pickup.name: Void Core
pickup.effect: Disrupts energy barriers

encounters.trigger: Sentinel's destruction collapses a barrier, revealing a path to the next encounter

encounters.hazard: Phase-shifting attacks that leave temporal echoes

pickup.name: Celestial Lens
pickup.effect: Reveals hidden vulnerabilities in celestial entities

encounters.trigger: Warden's defeat unlocks the Celestial Lens, which is required to see the boss's core

boss.name: Corrupted Star
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core revealed by the Celestial Lens

level.objective: Navigate the derelict Celestial Temple, defeat three guardians, and destroy the corrupted cosmic entity threatening the void

level.theme: Whimsical celestial adventure where the player's creativity and collected artifacts shape the path forward.
level.setting: A dreamlike realm of floating islands, prismatic light, and shifting constellations. The environment reacts to the player's illusions, creating temporary bridges or misleading mirages.
level.player_weapon: Prismatic Light (projects illusions and light beams)

encounters.hazard: Floating debris that creates temporary illusions, confusing the player.

pickup.name: Crystal Shard
pickup.effect: Unlocks the path to the next encounter

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Shadow Wraith causes the debris to coalesce into a glowing path leading to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Reflective surfaces that duplicate the player's attacks back at them.

pickup.name: Celestial Compass
pickup.effect: Reveals the location of the boss

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Mirror Sentinel's reflective barriers with the Crystal Shard causes the Compass to materialize, pointing toward the boss.

encounters.hazard: Illusions of the player's past failures that drain stamina.

pickup.name: Starlight Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the boss's true form

encounters.trigger: Using the Celestial Compass to pierce the Guardian's illusions reveals the Starlight Key, which opens the portal to the boss.

boss.name: Astral Sovereign
boss.weakness: Celestial Compass (obtained from the third encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by targeting its core with the Celestial Compass, which disrupts its illusions.

level.objective: Navigate the celestial realms, defeat three whimsical foes, and use collected pickups to uncover the boss's weakness.
level.reward: Celestial Crown (grants permanent illusion resistance and a chance to summon light shields)

level.setting: A turbulent celestial realm with unstable wormholes, colliding stars, and chaotic energy storms.
level.player_weapon: Lightning Staff (base damage: 50, enhanced by Storm Core)

encounters.hazard: Chaotic vortexes of plasma and debris

pickup.name: Storm Core
pickup.effect: Enhances lightning attacks by 30%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Serpent, the Storm Core destabilizes the nebula, revealing a path to the Gravity Warden's domain.

encounters.hazard: Unstable wormholes and gravity wells

pickup.name: Fracture Lens
pickup.effect: Highlights enemy weak points

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Warden's gravity shields with the Storm Core opens a rift leading to the Celestial Hydra's lair.

encounters.hazard: Colliding asteroids and solar flares

pickup.name: Starforge Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks access to the Leviathan's chamber

encounters.trigger: Using the Fracture Lens to destroy the Hydra's core releases the Starforge Key, which opens the Leviathan's prison.

boss.name: Celestial Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan by targeting its core with the Storm Core.

level.objective: Navigate the chaotic celestial realm to obtain pickups and defeat the Leviathan.
level.reward: Celestial Crown (grants immunity to environmental hazards)

level.setting: A ruined celestial temple suspended in the void, with shattered planets and floating debris. The air hums with static energy, and the ground is littered with crystalline fragments.
level.player_weapon: Celestial Bow (can be upgraded with Starbound Arrowhead)

enemy.name: Celestial Wraith
enemy.weakness: Piercing damage from the player's bow

encounters.hazard: Floating debris that periodically falls from the ceiling.

pickup.name: Starbound Arrowhead
pickup.effect: Increases arrow damage by 20%

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Celestial Wraith unlocks a hidden path to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Rock Elemental
enemy.weakness: Starbound Arrowhead (obtained from the first encounter)

encounters.hazard: Gravity anomalies that pull the player toward the ground.

pickup.name: Gravitic Core
pickup.effect: Disrupts enemy gravity fields for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Rock Elemental reveals a gravitational portal leading to the boss chamber.

boss.name: Celestial Colossus
boss.weakness: Gravitic Core (obtained from the second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Celestial Colossus by exploiting its gravity core vulnerability with the Gravitic Core pickup.

level.objective: Navigate the ruined celestial temple and defeat the Celestial Colossus.

level.theme: Eerie cosmic horror with mechanical elements, where the environment itself seems alive and hostile.
level.setting: A derelict celestial station with flickering neon lights, floating debris, and distorted gravity fields. The air hums with static, and distant whispers echo through broken speakers.
level.player_weapon: Plasma Lances (initial weapon; can be upgraded with pickups)

encounters.hazard: Gravity Well (pulls player toward the center of the chamber, increasing damage taken by 25% if not escaped)

pickup.name: Quantum Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Quantum Core (a glowing energy cell that can be weaponized or used to power mechanisms)

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Void Warden's crystalline armor triggers a collapsing ceiling, revealing a path to the next chamber.

encounters.hazard: Dimensional Fracture (randomly teleports the player to a hostile mirror realm for 10 seconds)

pickup.name: Celestial Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Celestial Key (a relic that emits a frequency disrupting the Sentinel's shields)

encounters.trigger: Using the Quantum Core on the Leviathan's core causes a chain reaction, breaching the reactor's containment field and exposing the final boss.

encounters.hazard: Celestial Storm (randomly summons debris that deals area damage and temporarily disables weapon systems)

pickup.name: Astral Forge
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Astral Forge (a permanent upgrade allowing the artificer to craft advanced mods)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Sentinel's shielded form with the Celestial Key reveals its true form, which can only be damaged by the key's frequency.

boss.name: Starforged Sentinel
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Sentinel by targeting its corrupted core with the Celestial Key

level.objective: Navigate the collapsing celestial station, defeat three guardians, and destroy the Starforged Sentinel by exploiting weaknesses from prior encounters.
level.reward: Astral Forge (permanent crafting station for artificers)

level.setting: A decaying space station orbiting a dying star, with flickering lights, warped metal corridors, and distant echoes of malfunctioning systems. The air is thin and filled with static electricity.

encounters.hazard: Corrosive coolant leaks from the drone's body

pickup.name: Stabilizer Module
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Stabilizer Module

encounters.trigger: Destroying the drone's core with the Plasma Cutter causes a nearby door to unlock, revealing the next area.

encounters.hazard: The being emits unstable energy waves that disrupt the player's tools

pickup.name: Gravity Anchor
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Gravity Anchor

encounters.trigger: Using the Stabilizer Module on the energy being causes it to collapse, revealing a hidden path to the boss arena.

boss.name: Celestial Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Leviathan's core using the Gravity Anchor to immobilize it, then strike its core with the Plasma Cutter.

level.objective: Navigate the derelict celestial station and defeat the Celestial Leviathan.
level.reward: Celestial Engineering Certification (unlocks new blueprints for starship modifications)
